group: Round 7 · Gear on the heroes: weapons in hand, armour worn
title: Armour worn 1: clothes, linen, plate and scale
use: Fixes the look of the armour worn on the heroes (game/js/entities/gear/armour.js), first half.
prompt: A costume sheet: the same blocky voxel hero, Percy Jackson (messy black hair, sea-green eyes), shown once per armour set in a row of figures at the same scale, each figure front-on with a small view from behind beside it (capes, quivers and wings show from behind), all in a neutral standing pose with the face clearly visible: helmets frame the face with cheek guards, hoods leave the face and the fringe showing. The armour is built from blocks over the hero's body: plates and pads on the chest, shoulders, forearms and shins, short strips or a robe hanging from the waist, capes from the shoulders. Flat light-grey background, no cast shadow. In this order: 1. Hermes Express Uniform: a navy delivery vest with a white stripe, a winged gold badge, a satchel on the back and a navy cap; 2. Linothorax: a cream linen cuirass in layered bands with blue trim, a shoulder yoke and linen strips at the waist; 3. Biker Jacket of Ares: a black leather jacket with silver zips and studs, flames up the back; 4. Hunter's Silver Parka: a silver-white parka with a fur-trimmed hood and a quiver of arrows; 5. Sea-Green Mail: rows of teal scales, scallop-shell shoulder plates and a gold shell clasp; 6. Hoplite Panoply: a bronze muscle cuirass, a crested Corinthian helmet, bronze bracers and greaves, leather strips at the waist; 7. Bronze Breastplate: a plain bronze cuirass with leather straps and a short leather skirt; 8. Satyr's Woven Vest: an open vest woven from green vines, leaves and a few flowers; 9. Camp Counsellor Vest: an orange vest with reflective stripes, a lanyard and a whistle; 10. Fireproof Forge Apron: a thick leather apron with tongs in the pocket, embers in the leather, heavy gloves; 11. Armour of the Amazons: a red leather cuirass with gold scales, gold bracers, one gold shoulder plate and a quiver; 12. Drakon-Scale Plate: dark green scale armour with gold belly plates, spiked shoulders and a horned scale helmet. 3D game art in the blocky voxel style of Minecraft Dungeons: characters built from cubes, with a large cube head whose face is simple pixel art (about 8 × 8 pixels: pixel eyes, a pixel mouth, hair drawn as pixels and as a few blocky tufts), a boxy torso, square arms and legs, crisp pixel-art textures (about 16 pixels per block) with simple shading, chunky readable silhouettes; warm cinematic lighting, soft ambient occlusion and glowing magic effects. Costume colours and details follow the Camp Half-Blood cartoon concept art. Palette: camp orange #f28c28, sea teal #0f6f73, deep navy #10233d, jade #2e8b6e, coral #e8664a, bronze gold #c9963a, lightning yellow #ffd84a, parchment cream #f4ead5, vase black #17130f and owl grey #8c96a3. No lettering, logos, captions or watermark.
